::: {#exm-subset-intersection}
#### Intersecting with a larger set

Let $B = \set{1, 2, 3, 4}$.

- $\set{2, 4} \subseteq B$, and $\set{2, 4} \cap B = \set{2, 4}$, as @thm-subset-intersection says.
- $\set{2, 5} \not\subseteq B$, since $5 \notin B$,
  and $\set{2, 5} \cap B = \set{2}$, which is not $\set{2, 5}$.

:::
